research_question: On an independent CN/US sample, does the already pre-defined SETUP_01 ARMED milestone, used as an earlier-entry trigger, reproduce a price-space improvement relative to the incumbent first-CONFIRMED entry, while keeping failure, non-confirmation and adverse-excursion cost within pre-registered bounds?

prior_evidence.selection_basis: The single experimental group is fixed from the exposed Development evidence before the new sample is read: it is the only registered earlier-entry candidate that is already a pre-defined production milestone (SETUP01_RECOVERY_RATIO = 0.5). No milestone search, no new filter combination, and no threshold sweep is performed on the new sample.
prior_evidence.development_result_boundary: PRE_CONFIRMATION_EARLY_ENTRY_CAUSAL_RESEARCH_V1 stayed at READY_FOR_DECISION and did not support execution/cost research; the confirmed-after-retest study remains closed and is not reopened by this protocol.

single_experimental_group.milestone: first causal primary/alternate WAVE_2_TO_3 context observation, with all three Swing anchors already confirmed, before confirmation or invalidation, where close >= LOW2 + 0.5 * (H1 - LOW2) and close <= H1
single_experimental_group.production_equivalence: the same predicate as the existing SETUP_01 ARMED state (trading/setup01.py: close >= Wave 2 low + SETUP01_RECOVERY_RATIO * (Wave 1 peak - Wave 2 low), close <= Wave 1 peak, SETUP01_RECOVERY_RATIO = 0.5), evaluated as an entry trigger rather than a state label
single_experimental_group.signal_count_per_lifecycle: one first signal per Wave2 anchor context

comparator.milestone: first causal day with state == CONFIRMED, which requires close > H1
comparator.selection: one signal per lifecycle; no Decision/RR/target gate is added to this structural timing comparator

independence.symbol_level: the frozen roster manifest proves empty intersections with the A1 formal 120, the earlier development universe v1 and the second development holdout (the sample used by PRE_CONFIRMATION_EARLY_ENTRY_CAUSAL_RESEARCH_V1); no symbol and therefore no lifecycle identity is shared with the exposed Development data
independence.lifecycle_level: anchor-contract identities are (symbol, LOW0 pivot, H1 pivot, LOW2 pivot); because the symbol sets are disjoint, no anchor context, confirmation, failure or censored lifecycle can be re-used across samples
independence.time_level: the calendar window deliberately matches the frozen Development window so that the comparison differs only by entity; therefore this sample is NOT time-independent and market-regime overlap is a disclosed limitation rather than a claimed control. Pre-registered time halves are reported descriptively
independence.parameter_level: all signal definitions, bands and thresholds come from the already registered PRE_CONFIRMATION_EARLY_ENTRY_CAUSAL_RESEARCH_V1 milestone and from this frozen protocol; no parameter was fitted on the new sample
independence.prior_exposure_disclosure: the same 40 symbols were previously used for a different hypothesis (SETUP_03 ATR-normalized platform boundary structural qualification, which stopped at STOP_SETUP_03_STRUCTURAL_DEVELOPMENT). That work involved no SETUP_01 Wave2 earlier-entry signal, outcome, target or Decision, and the roster was frozen from metadata snapshots only before any OHLCV was read.

sample.payload_identity_rule: the price payload is re-acquired under the frozen provider contract and frozen as a new dataset identity with its own hashes; per-symbol hash comparison against the 2026-08-29 clean-holdout dataset manifest is recorded as informational consistency evidence only and a mismatch is never substituted or hidden

qc_rules.acceptance: all 40 roster symbols must return VALID_ACCEPTED with a non-empty exact-window history; otherwise the dataset is BLOCKER_FAIL_CLOSED and first-stage validation cannot run

denominator.cohort_rule: every strict as-of causal primary/alternate WAVE_2_TO_3 anchor context whose LOW0, H1 and LOW2 Swing identities are confirmed as of the observation, rebuilt from the frozen sample with the unchanged Wave/Swing engine; the cohort is rebuilt from contexts and never from the later CONFIRMED subset
required_composition: screened out by the current system
invalid Wave2 geometry contexts retained as screened rows
denominator.common_denominator: both the experimental group and the incumbent are reported against the same full anchor-context cohort per market; suppressed, failed, unconfirmed and right-censored lifecycles stay in the denominator and are never dropped
denominator.no_survivorship: no filtering on later confirmation, later failure, price path, MFE/MAE, return, target reach or any outcome label

causal_contract.signal_information: only Quote data and existing causal replay/Wave/Swing state with data <= signal date
causal_contract.event_identity: same anchor-context identity and same first-signal semantics as the registered Development protocol; exactly one first signal per lifecycle per policy
causal_contract.executable_entry: the exact next date in the frozen market-session union must carry a unique finite OPEN for the symbol; otherwise the signal is not executable and is reported as censored for entry metrics
causal_contract.later_bar_substitution: forbidden; a missing next session is never replaced by a later bar and never by T+2
causal_contract.missing_data: absent dates stay absent; no interpolation, no synthetic bar, no provider switch, no fill
causal_contract.outcome_use: confirmation, failure, adverse excursion, hurdle and headroom results are post-definition evaluation only and never feed back into signal selection or into the sample

metrics.price_space_primary: paired normalized headroom gain over Wave1 R = H1 - LOW0, defined as (incumbent exact next-session OPEN - early exact next-session OPEN) / R on lifecycles where both entries are executable; equivalent for the H1, Fib1.272 and Fib1.618 reference levels because the targets are fixed per lifecycle
metrics.paired_population: lifecycles with both an executable early entry and an executable incumbent entry; paired count, median and p10/p25/p75/p90 are reported per market
metrics.sign_test: exact two-sided binomial sign test on the paired gain signs (ties excluded), evaluated per market
metrics.failure_cost: structural invalidation before confirmation count and share of executable early signals; failed, never-CONFIRMED and screened-out composition; censored and ambiguous counts
metrics.adverse_excursion: minimum observed low from the executable early entry through confirmation, close-based structural invalidation, screened-out replacement boundary or dataset end, normalized by R; reported with the paired increment against the incumbent
metrics.coverage_and_missing: signaled, not-signaled, executable, not-executable and right-censored counts on the common denominator, plus dataset QC coverage
metrics.descriptive_only: no P&L, no return, no win rate, no expectancy, no Sharpe, no execution cost and no broker outcome is computed in this stage

descriptive_levels: time half by frozen market-session ordinal

floors.floor_derivation: conservative fractions (about 10% of anchor contexts and about 8-15% of the exposed Development signal/paired counts) used only to stop sparse-sample over-reading; failing a floor yields INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never NOT_SUPPORTED

space_improvement.median_min_derivation: about 38% of the exposed Development paired median gain of 0.2643 R; a smaller independent-sample gain is treated as too small to carry an earlier-entry design

invalidation_control.derivation: exposed Development shares are CN 0.2260 and US 0.2367; the bound adds an independent-sample tolerance of roughly 11-12 percentage points

confirmation_control.derivation: exposed Development shares are CN 0.2831 and US 0.3569; the floor is roughly 8-15 percentage points below them and marks a materially weaker confirmation yield

decision_rules.evaluation: each market is classified independently; all three gates must hold in both CN and US for the first stage to be supported, which is a stricter conjunction than two independent tests because no diversification across markets is allowed
decision_rules.post_hoc_rule_change: forbidden; a failed or insufficient classification is reported as-is and cannot be re-run with new thresholds, new symbols, a longer window or additional strata

stopping_rules: dataset QC not ready, universe binding changed, or any roster symbol not VALID_ACCEPTED -> stop with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and keep the diagnostics
cohort or paired population below the pre-registered floors -> stop with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
leakage, duplicated lifecycle identity across samples, or a non-causal signal detected -> stop, report the violation, and do not publish a supported classification
no sample replacement, no window extension, no parameter search, no additional milestone after the first result
out_of_scope: execution cost, spread, slippage, commission or net return
win rate, expectancy, Sharpe, portfolio drawdown or allocation
new Stop, Target, Entry Zone, 5%, 2R, position sizing or admission rules
Paper ledger, production state, Sheets writes or broker orders
Final OOS or any formal validation set
forbidden: modifying confirmation, target semantics, 5% gate, 2R, Stop, Wave, Swing or Fib
milestone search or new filter combinations
sample replacement or window extension after the first result
broker, state write or Sheets mutation
mixing production data-quality repair with this research

outputs.event_detail: compact aggregate plus paired evidence only; no raw bars, no private holdings
